title: Barrier
body:
Syntax: perform barrier

Description: A defensive chakra barrier negates 25% of incoming damage for three minutes without changing Armor Class. Leaving the room breaks it. Raises a defensive barrier for three minutes (25% less incoming damage, no Armor Class bonus). Moving to another room breaks it. Usable with any chakra nature. Unlocks at level 35. Costs 30 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 12 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
